name: ultimate-sdd
description: Local-first spec-driven development: PRDs, EPICs, REQs, verifiable TASKs, CHANGE deltas, and delivery pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first spec-driven development for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Local-first spec-driven development: project-owned setup and context, behavior-first PRDs, EPIC/REQ/TASK planning, proportionate technical design, per-task TDD, ordered spec and quality review, evidence freshness gates, CHANGE/truth deltas, checkpoints, and read-only rollback previews. Stdlib Python tools check local state; host support determines independent subagent execution. Explicit resume works without Claude lifecycle hooks.
defaultPrompt: Plan this idea into EPICs and REQs.
Create a rigorous PRD for this product idea.
Load the next task for the coding agent.
Propose a change that adds a countdown to the launches list.
